statements.subject: task
statements.description: "state": "submitted" — task status state returned in the server response immediately after a push-notification-enabled task is submitted via message:send

statements.subject: task
statements.description: "state": "TASK_STATE_COMPLETED" — task status state delivered via push notification webhook when the long-running task finishes

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: pushNotificationConfig contains url field specifying the client webhook endpoint to receive status notifications

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: pushNotificationConfig contains token field holding a client-provided security token echoed back in X-A2A-Notification-Token header of webhook POST

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: pushNotificationConfig contains authentication field specifying how the server should authenticate when posting to the webhook

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: pushNotificationConfig.authentication contains schemes field listing accepted authentication scheme names (e.g. ["Bearer"])

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Webhook notification payload contains top-level statusUpdate object with taskId field identifying the task whose status changed

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Webhook notification payload statusUpdate contains contextId field identifying the task's context

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Webhook notification payload statusUpdate contains status object carrying the updated task state and timestamp

statements.subject: push_notification
statements.description: Server includes X-A2A-Notification-Token HTTP header in the webhook POST, containing the token value from the original pushNotificationConfig, enabling the client to verify notification authenticity

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Client sends POST /message:send with configuration.pushNotificationConfig; server responds HTTP 200 with task object whose status.state is 'submitted'
actions: Server receives POST /message:send with pushNotificationConfig in configuration
Server registers pushNotificationConfig.url and pushNotificationConfig.token for the new task
Server responds HTTP 200 with task object containing id, contextId, and status.state = submitted

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Later: Server POSTs Notification to Webhook — when the long-running task completes, server transitions task to TASK_STATE_COMPLETED and sends a statusUpdate payload to the registered webhook URL using Bearer JWT authentication and the echoed notification token
actions: Server sets task status to TASK_STATE_COMPLETED with updated timestamp
Server constructs statusUpdate payload containing taskId, contextId, and status object
Server POSTs statusUpdate payload to pushNotificationConfig.url with Content-Type: application/a2a+json
Server includes Authorization: Bearer <server-generated-jwt> header in webhook POST
Server includes X-A2A-Notification-Token header set to pushNotificationConfig.token value
